briefdescription.para: The number of nearest neighbor points to use for building of local triangulation.

simplesect.para:
Too small value can make not optimal triangulation and additional holes Too big value increases difficulty of optimization and decreases performance
"Good" width = 350cm "Too small value" width = 350cm

briefdescription.para: Radius of neighborhood around each point to consider for building local triangulation. This is an alternative to numNeighbours parameter. Please set to positive value only one of them.

Critical angle of triangles in local triangulation (angle between triangles in fan should be less then this value) <table border=0> <caption id="TriangulationParameters::critAngle_examples"></caption> <tr> <td>.
the vertex is considered as boundary if its neighbor ring has angle more than this value
Critical length of hole (all holes with perimeter up to this value will be filled)

detaileddescription.para: If value is negative, it is set automatically to 0.1 * (bounding box diagonal of the point cloud)

briefdescription.para: automatic increase of the radius if points outside can make triangles from original radius not-Delone
optional: if provided this cloud will be used for searching of neighbors (so it must have same validPoints)
